name: specbaton
description: Spec-driven development with Claude Code: memory that survives sessions, and a read-only second agent that plans and reviews.

plugins.name: specbaton
plugins.description: Session memory for spec-driven work: ADRs, one change per session, resume-work and handoff, triggered by hooks.

plugins.name: specbaton-reviewer
plugins.description: A second agent (Cursor, Antigravity, Claude with another model, or any CLI) that writes the plan and reviews the code, read-only and verified.
